{{Quote|Kiran Tatch just about got me and some fellow operatives killed about a year ago in the Xorao system.|Anson Blazer, personal addendum to Rebel Task Force on Alliance Security SecuriDex file on Kiran Tatch|<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>}}
The '''Xorao system''' was a part of the [[Mezeg sector/Legends|Mezeg sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', which establishes that [[Anson Blazer]] encountered [[Kiran Tatch]] in the Xorao [[Star system/Legends|system]] approximately one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] prior to its setting, represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one year before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operatives, including the [[Human/Legends|Human]] agent [[Anson Blazer]], conducted low-level infiltration assignments in the Xorao [[Star system/Legends|system]] as part of its investigation of the criminal group known as the [[Kalstan gangsters]].<ref name="AIR" />

The team was discovered by [[Kiran Tatch]], a [[Tunroth]] member of the [[Tunroth Hunter]]s cultural group who was not affiliated with the [[Gangster/Legends|gangsters]] in any way. Nevertheless, Tatch immediately reported the Rebels, leading to them being pursued. The Alliance operatives were forced to abandon both their operation and a significant stockpile of valuable equipment, and they were nearly [[Death/Legends|killed]] but ultimately managed to escape. Approximately [[2 ABY/Legends|one year]] later, Blazer mentioned the incident in a personal addendum to a [[Task Force on Alliance Security]] [[SecuriDex]] [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] on Tatch.<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Xorao system was first mentioned in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AIR" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' subsequently placed it in grid square M-7.<ref name="TEA" />
